meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 40) — the zb second layer swept in three more yearbooks; the two long-nodeless trade hubs minted; round 39's Shanghai authorship ruling corrected against the instruments themselves
meta.note: ROUND 40. THREE FINDINGS AND ONE CORRECTION OF A RULING MADE THE DAY BEFORE. (1) **THE zb SECOND LAYER IS NOT A NATIONAL-YEARBOOK QUIRK — Shandong, Xi'an and Fujian all publish one, and nobody had fetched any of them.** Round 38 found the national yearbook's left.htm listing html/smNN.htm AND html/zbNN.pdf side by side and swept the zb layer for the first time; its own meta then said of Shandong, Wuhan and Xi'an that 'their chapter notes were swept in rounds 31/35 and none of the recorded 《》 titles is either hub, so there is nothing to re-read there.' That was wrong, and the way it was wrong is the lesson: it re-checked the TITLES ALREADY RECORDED instead of re-reading the TOC to see whether a whole layer had gone unopened. Shandong's left.htm lists 21 zbNN.pdf beside the 25 smNN.pdf round 35 swept (plus three w25NN.pdf appendix files); Xi'an's lists 22 beside 22; Fujian's lists 19 beside 21. **Re-read left.htm's href list for every yearbook already 'done'** — the question is not what the notes said, it is which files were never fetched. (2) **《关于工资总额组成的规定》 IS AN NBS INSTRUMENT AND ROUND 38 FILED IT UNDER THE WRONG PUBLISHER.** Round 38 listed it among 'EIGHT [that] NEED A NON-NBS PUBLISHER'S OWN PAGE FOUND', which is why nobody looked on stats.gov.cn. It is 国家统计局令第1号, approved by the State Council 1989-09-30 and issued by NBS on 1990-01-01, and NBS publishes its full text. Minted here and wired to THREE independent yearbooks. **And finding it exposed a THIRD NBS listing the method file does not name**: `https://www.stats.gov.cn/zs/flfg/tjlydnfghflfg/` (统计领域的法规), alongside the known 统计制度 (`/sj/tjzd/`) and 统计标准 (`/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/`) listings. It carries 15 instruments including 全国人口普查条例, 全国经济普查条例 and 中华人民共和国统计法实施条例 — two of which are standing nodeless leads. (3) **A PROVINCIAL BUREAU PUBLISHES A 年定报制度目录 — A CATALOGUE OF EVERY REPORTING SYSTEM IT ADMINISTERS, ONE LANDING PAGE AND ONE FIRST-PARTY PDF EACH.** Shanghai's is at `/ndbzdml/index.html`, 20 instruments for the 2025 年报/2026 定报 cycle. This is a new portal SHAPE, not a Shanghai fact: it is where a province's instruments live, and it is what finally produced pages for the two hubs below. **THE CORRECTION, AND IT OVERTURNS ROUND 39's HEADLINE RULE.** Round 39 read Shanghai's yearbook saying 上海市统计局制定的《固定资产投资统计报表制度》 and 上海市统计局制定的《房地产开发统计报表制度》, concluded these were 'Shanghai's own instruments wearing NBS's titles', dropped both as `wrong-target`, and wrote the rule AUTHORSHIP INSIDE THE SENTENCE DECIDES THE TARGET into PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7a. **The instruments themselves say otherwise.** Both covers, read this round from the bureau's own catalogue, read 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制 — NBS formulated; Shanghai supplemented and printed. So do the covers of 建筑业统计报表制度 and 劳动工资统计报表制度, which round 39 DID wire to NBS nodes off 国家统计局制定的. The corpus was therefore treating four identically-authored instruments two different ways, and the yearbook's own prose is simply loose about which bureau 制定 the local edition it used. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: wire both to the NBS nodes. The two round-39 `_dropped` entries are rewritten `resolved` in place. **What survives of round 39's rule, and it is worth keeping:** a sentence naming an issuer is still the thing to read, and a provincial instrument with a national title is still a real category — Shanghai's catalogue proves it, because the entries whose titles carry 上海市 (上海市核算综合统计报表制度, 上海市建设领域基本信息综合统计报表制度) say 上海市统计局制定 or 上海市统计局印制 with no NBS line at all. **The catalogue splits exactly along the title prefix.** What does NOT survive is inferring the issuer from the yearbook's sentence when the instrument itself is one fetch away. Read the instrument, not the citation, before recording a look-alike. **THE TWO TRADE HUBS ARE MINTED, after being named by four independent yearbooks across eleven rounds with no page ever found.** 《批发和零售业统计报表制度》 and 《住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度》 have been the standing parked lead since round 29 — named by the national, Guangdong, Shandong and Shanghai yearbooks, absent from NBS's 统计制度 listing and from round 30's article-id probe past its truncation. Shanghai's catalogue carries both, and both covers read 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: mint both off that edition, on rule 19's principle that authorship decides, not host. **ROUTE CAVEAT, recorded because the node URLs are not the issuer's own site:** each node is cited to its Shanghai landing page, which is first-party to a statistical bureau and carries the full instrument as a PDF attachment, but no NBS-hosted page for either has ever been found and this round did not find one either. If one turns up, move the URL and keep the node. **NOT DONE, and cheap:** Guangdong's yearbook names both hubs too and would be a fifth and sixth edge each, but it ships only as the CD zip and was not opened this round. Jiangsu's ch14 names them as well. Xi'an's zb21 names 《广播电视人口覆盖率统计技术标准和方法》 and its zb12/zb18 name 《小企业会计准则》 (MOF) — both nodeless, the first now with three independent citations. Fujian's zb layer was fetched and is **as unextractable as its sm layer** — 1-page iText wrappers with no font table and no image list, zero characters out of all five tested; the round-37 verdict stands for both layers and nobody should re-probe it.

reports.title: 关于工资总额组成的规定 (Provisions on the Composition of Total Wages)
title_aliases: 关于工资总额组成的规定
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The standing NBS instrument that defines what counts as 工资总额 (total wages) for every Chinese statistical and accounting return — approved by the State Council on 1989-09-30 and issued by the National Bureau of Statistics as 国家统计局令第1号 on 1990-01-01, effective from the date of issue. 第四条 fixes the six components (计时工资, 计件工资, 奖金, 津贴和补贴, 加班加点工资, 特殊情况下支付的工资) and 第二条 binds every enterprise, institution, joint venture, state organ, party organ and social organisation to it in their planning, statistical and accounting treatment of the wage bill. It is the definitional hub behind the employment-and-wage chapter of the national yearbook and of the provincial and city yearbooks, which cite it by title where they define 工资总额, and it is why those series are comparable across the whole system. Distinct from 《劳动工资统计报表制度》 (cn-nbs-wage-reporting-system), which is the annually reissued COLLECTION instrument; this is the standing definition the collection applies.
reports.cadence_note: A standing ministerial provision, in force unamended since 1990-01-01 rather than reissued on a cycle. The NBS page read for this round is the 2025 republication of the same text.

reports.title: 批发和零售业统计报表制度 (Wholesale and Retail Trade Statistical Reporting System)
title_aliases: 批发和零售业统计报表制度
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing China's wholesale and retail trade statistics — the instrument behind the 限额以上 (above-threshold) reporting units, the commodity-turnover and financial-position tables, the retail chain returns and the total retail sales of consumer goods that the national, provincial and municipal yearbooks all publish. The national yearbook's own chapter note sets the thresholds it implements: annual principal business revenue of 20 million yuan and above for a wholesale unit, 5 million and above for a retail unit. Reissued annually alongside the periodic reporting forms. FOUR independent yearbooks name it by title — the national, Guangdong, Shandong and Shanghai ones — which is why it is minted; NO NBS-HOSTED PAGE HAS EVER BEEN FOUND for it, on the 统计制度 listing or past that listing's truncation, so the node is cited to the Shanghai bureau's own catalogue entry, whose attached PDF carries the cover line 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制. Move the URL if an NBS-hosted page turns up.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic reporting forms; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic forms.

reports.title: 住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度 (Accommodation and Catering Statistical Reporting System)
title_aliases: 住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing China's accommodation and catering statistics — the basic-condition, operating and financial tables for above-threshold accommodation and catering legal-person enterprises and self-employed operators, and the catering chain-headquarters returns. The national yearbook's chapter note gives the threshold it implements: annual principal business revenue of 2 million yuan and above. The twin of cn-nbs-wholesale-retail-reporting-system, issued and reissued alongside it, and named in the same sentence by the Shandong and Shanghai yearbooks. Minted on the same basis and with the same caveat: four independent yearbooks name it, no NBS-hosted page has ever been found, and the node is cited to the Shanghai bureau's catalogue entry whose attached PDF reads 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制 on its cover.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic reporting forms; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic forms.
